gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Victron Blue Smart IP65 has no cold-charging cutoff of its own: its manual says not to charge Li-ion below 0 °C, yet the charger runs to −20 °C and turns off temperature compensation in Li-ion mode. In a cold boat or RV it is only safe with a battery whose BMS stops charging at 0 °C (Redodo's low-temp and self-heating 100 Ah models stop below 32 °F and start again at 41 °F). US buyers also need the 120 V model (100–130 VAC input), not the 230 V one (180–265 VAC) that ChatGPT cited in one chat.
standout_why: Compared against Victron's product page and tech-spec pages (cited by ChatGPT), clampandcrank.com (ranks 4 chargers) and ChatGPT's own answers. The Victron product page that ChatGPT cited already mentions 'automatic under-voltage protection reset' and says the charger works from -20 °C to 50 °C 'without special settings'. It never says not to charge Li-ion below 0 °C. ChatGPT's third answer and clampandcrank give only a general caution about charging LiFePO4 near freezing. Neither ties it to a specific charger and battery pair, or to the Victron manual's own warning. Gearranking and solargenadvisor could not be opened (certificate error), so I could not compare against them. In chat pl-084 ChatGPT cited the 230 V spec page for a US shopper. No result separates the 120 V and 230 V input ranges.
decides: This confirms Victron as the pick for boats and RVs only if the battery has its own low-temperature charge cutoff or self-heating, so the page should state that pairing in the Victron row. It also fills our Victron 'Wakes a shut-off BMS' cell, which currently reads 'Not stated by the dealer'. Victron's manual says the charger 'will automatically reset UVP and start charging'. For US buyers it narrows the Victron choice to the 120 V version. Redodo 20A is $82.99 today, which keeps it as the budget 20 A pick over LiTime ($102.99 on our page, 2026-11-06).

findings.label: Wakes a battery whose BMS has tripped under-voltage protection
findings.value: Yes. The manual says 'will automatically reset UVP and start charging'
findings.source_title: Blue Smart IP65 Charger 120V manual – Features
findings.note: Section 3, item 9 (Li-ion). The manual says many other chargers do not recognise a battery in this state. The product page (https://www.victronenergy.com/chargers/blue-smart-ip65-charger) also says 'automatic under-voltage protection reset'. No reactivation voltage threshold is published.

findings.label: Cold-charging limit for Li-ion
findings.value: Do not charge Li-ion below 0 °C (32 °F). The charger has no cutoff of its own for this.
findings.source_title: Blue Smart IP65 Charger 120V manual – Features
findings.note: The manual says: 'Warning: Do not charge Li-ion batteries if the battery temperature is below 0°C.' Item 5 says temperature compensation is 'automatically disabled when in LI-ION charge mode'. The operating range is -20 to 50 °C, so the charger keeps running below freezing. The battery's BMS has to block cold charging.

findings.label: Li-ion preset voltages
findings.value: Absorption 14.2 V, no float, storage 13.5 V. 4-stage algorithm in Li-ion mode.
findings.source_title: Blue Smart IP65 Charger 120V manual – 9. Technical specifications
findings.note: The Redodo, LiTime and NOCO chargers on our page charge LiFePO4 to 14.6 V. Victron's Li-ion preset stops at 14.2 V. Temperature compensation is listed as 'N/A for Li-ion'.

findings.label: Output current, Max and Low modes
findings.value: 15 A in Max mode, 4 A in Low mode
findings.source_title: Blue Smart IP65 Charger 120V manual – 9. Technical specifications
findings.note: Low mode is meant for small batteries on a large charger (features page, item 12).

findings.value: Only 12 V (12.8 V) LiFePO4. Pre-charge stage wakes a battery whose BMS has shut off.
findings.note: Read from the maker's Shopify store with storecheck.py search. The page says it is 'uniquely designed for 12V(12.8V) LiFePO4 batteries' with a 3-stage pre-charge, constant-current and constant-voltage algorithm, and 'can activate lithium battery protected by BMS'. 2-year warranty.

findings.label: Battery-side low-temperature charge cutoff (pairs with Victron)
findings.value: Charging stops below 32 °F (0 °C) and starts again above 41 °F (5 °C)
findings.source_title: Redodo 12V 100Ah Lithium Trolling Motor Battery With Low Temp Protection
findings.note: From storecheck.py search. This is the BMS cutoff the Victron manual's 0 °C warning relies on. The Group 24 Bluetooth and Ultra-Mini Bluetooth models list the same cutoff.

findings.label: Self-heating behaviour while charging
findings.value: 100 W heating pads switch on below 32 °F (0 °C). Charging is held until the battery reaches 41 °F (5 °C).
findings.note: From storecheck.py search. Price $251.99. The page does not say whether the charger or the battery powers the heater, or what minimum charger current it needs (see unsourced).
